reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: Ashby Monk discusses investor identity, technology, and ESG investing impacts on returns.
reader_summary.overview: This replayed episode features Dr. Ashby Monk discussing his research on how investor identity drives financial results. The conversation explores how technology enables better decisions and examines the importance of measuring both losses and recovery periods in ESG investing strategies.

key_points.text: Investor identity acts as the ultimate driver of investment returns for all asset owners.
key_points.evidence_quote: Investor Identity: The Ultimate Driver of Returns

key_points.text: Technological innovation serves as a key enabler that helps improve investment outcomes.
Investors must consider the combined drawdown and recovery period when making decisions.

reader_summary.why_it_matters: Listeners learn how identity and technology shape long-term investment success.

notes: Dr. Ashby Monk is the Executive & Research Director of the Stanford Research Initiative on Long-Term Investing. Ashby has studied and advised the largest asset owners in the world for more than twenty years with a particular interest in how to improve outcomes for their beneficiaries and the world. Ash also serves as the Head of Research at Addepar, a fintech company that helps investors make smarter decisions. He has twice appeared on the show – as the 29th guest back in 2017 and again two years ago – and those conversations are replayed in the feed. Our conversation starts with a recent paper Ashby published called Investor Identity: The Ultimate Driver of Returns. We discuss the descriptors of identity and enabling factors that determine each investor's fingerprint. From there, we dive into technology as an enabler and how technological innovation can improve returns. We then turn to ESG investing and another of Ashby's recent papers, Submergence = Drawdown + Recovery, that discusses the importance of considering the combined drawdown and recovery period in making investment decisions. For full show notes, visit the episode webpage here .  About the Podcast 
 
 
 Allocator and asset management expert, Ted Seides, conducts in-depth interviews with leaders in the institutional investing industry. Guests include Chief Investment Officers from leading allocators, asset managers, strategists, thought leaders, and many more. Our mission is to learn, share, and help implement the process of premier investors. Learn more and join our community at capitalallocators.com.
